name: Momiji
message: 「……Alright, it’s time for the post-mortem review.」
Before me sits a 350ml non-alcoholic beer.
I open it right away and let it flow down my throat.

name: Momiji
message: 「Glug… glug…」

name: Momiji
message: 「Phaaah~, Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Wait, no it’s not！ This isn't the time for that！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, geez, stupid, stupid, I’m so stupid！」
I thrash around on my bed.

name: Momiji
message: 「What was that about ‘I have no intention of getting involved with you’?！ Stop trying to act so cool, Momiji！」
I cringe while replaying the conversation with Iori-sensei earlier.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, why did I have to go and say something like that to Iori-sensei?」
Even though, in truth, I was actually happy that he paid attention to me…
Well, I do know the reason why.

name: Momiji
message: 「Because Sensei asked me if ‘I like being alone’ and all that…」
It’s not like I particularly hate being alone. But it’s not like I love it either.

name: Momiji
message: 「I just ended up wanting to test him, didn’t I…」
When I’m interested in someone, I want to find out what kind of person they really are. That’s why I end up asking these weird questions.

name: Momiji
message: 「But then I do stuff like that and end up pushing them away~」
Even though I know it, I can’t break this habit.

name: Momiji
message: 「Sigh, how did I end up like this…」
I mutter to myself while sipping on the non―alc beer. How I ended up this way is―
…The people of the Suzakuin clan grip a wooden sword at two, and a real blade at four. And at five, they begin their training in Jindou.
By the time I was around seven, everyone around me started Jindou too, and I finally made friends my own age.

name: Girl
message: 「Hey Momiji, let’s go home together.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, let’s go！」
…Up until then, I had been swinging my sword all by myself, so I was incredibly happy to have a friend.

name: Girl
message: 「You’re entering the junior division of the Jindou tournament, right, Momiji? I’m going to be in it too.」

name: Girl
message: 「Let’s both do our best.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, let’s both do our best!」
I had made such a close friend. Back then, I loved Jindou more than anything every single day.

name: Umpire
message: 「That is all！ ……Winner, Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thank you very much！」

name: Girl
message: 「...Thank you very much」
...But ever since I won the junior division at the Jindou tournament. Little by little, the gears started slipping out of place.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, hey, let's do some mutual sparring」

name: Girl
message: 「...Sorry, I don't want to practice with you, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh...? Why?」

name: Girl
message: 「Because you're so strong, Momiji... I can't beat you」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's not true, let's work hard together」

name: Girl
message: 「I'm sorry...」
She gradually drifted away from me and grew close to another girl. She stopped walking home with me.

name: Girl
message: 「Hey, I've decided to quit this dojo」

name: Momiji
message: 「O-Oh, I see. Why are you quitting？」

name: Girl
message: 「Because watching you made me realize it's impossible」

name: Girl
message: 「No matter how hard I try, I'll never beat you, Momiji. So there's no point trying here anymore」

name: Girl
message: 「It's all your fault, Momiji」
...And just like that, my close friend left the dojo.

name: Boy
message: 「W-What the hell are you... That's insane！ How the hell did you dodge that?！」

name: Boy
message: 「Forget it, I'm quitting Jindou！ I'm so done with this crap！」
Even after that... kids like them kept showing up, over and over again.

name: Dojo Junior A
message: 「Ah, Momiji-san...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Where are you all going？」

name: Dojo Junior A
message: 「Um, just stopping by a pancake shop on the way home」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, that sounds delicious. Can I come with you？」

name: Dojo Junior A
message: 「I'm sorry, since it's just close friends going...」

name: Momiji
message: 「...O-Oh, I see, sorry」
Until no one would come near me anymore.

name: Dojo Junior B
message: 「Hey, why’d you turn Suzakuin-san down？」

name: Dojo Junior A
message: 「Well, it’s depressing being around Suzakuin-san, right? There’s just no way you could ever beat someone like that…」

name: Dojo Junior B
message: 「People from the Suzakuin Family, they’re just like a different species, aren’t they.」

name: Dojo Junior A
message: 「Yeah, I think they’re monsters.」
…Called a monster, shunned by everyone.

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s… fine, whatever.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If that’s how it is, I’m better off alone.」
If I stay by myself, I won’t get hurt for no reason—

name: Momiji
message: 「……Ugh, I went and remembered something shitty.」
Being smart has its drawbacks. No matter how much time passes, the unpleasant past never fades.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, screw it, desperation-cider time！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew… ah, I wish I could drink the real stuff.」
If I did, maybe those nasty memories would blur a little.

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I’m a total loner, I get it. Not like I care anyway—long live my solo life, actually.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And it’s all, every last bit of it, Iori-sensei’s fault!」
Ever since that man became the assistant homeroom teacher for Takamura Class, my life has been nothing but a mess.

name: Momiji
message: 「But… funny enough, I don’t actually hate it.」
If it were the old me, I definitely would’ve rejected him. No, at first, I did.
Yet Iori-sensei kept coming, so sincere, never giving up, worming his way into my heart.
I wish he were just a jerk, I really do. Then I could’ve rejected him without a second thought.

name: Momiji
message: 「That guy is just way too good-natured…」
And a man like that… actually wants me, so aggressively.

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s so unfair…」
Well, regardless.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Iori-sensei, sorry.」
I know I’m a brat… but please, I don’t want you to hate me.
